# Whole Latte Love

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Online store on Shopify selling espresso machines, coffee makers, grinders, coffee and tea, and machine parts and accessories. Its shipping policy states free standard shipping on qualifying retail orders to the contiguous United States (excluding Hawaii, Alaska and Puerto Rico) and offers shipping to Canada; the page does not state whether it delivers to the excluded areas.
